name: Nihongo Master v1.5.16 - Unified Character Sizes Across Racers
changelog: v1.5.16: Unified character sizing on cars across both Hiragana Racer and Katakana Racer for absolute visual consistency. Player karts now render Kana at 33pt, and traffic rival karts render Romaji at 31pt (1-char), 26pt (2-char), and 21pt (3-char) on aerodynamic racing plates.
